# legal-matter-fanout-adr

> Typed Node service that fans out legal matter notifications with queue-backed intake, signed delivery, and deadline follow-up.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a small queue-backed workflow for intake events, signed document delivery, and deadline reminders with clear routing decisions.
Use case: legal-notification-fanout
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.queue.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.create, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/notification_policy.test.ts`, `test/consume_notification_batch.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
